made_by: Yakagadzirwa nemugadziri mumwe akazvimirira akaneta nemawebhusaiti ekuverenga akazara nekushambadza. Wawana chikanganiso? Chitaure paGitHub.
donate_text: Mahara, hapana kushambadza, yakagadzirwa nemunhu mumwe. Kana izvi zvakuponesa rwendo rwekudzokera kuchitoro, unogona kunditengera kofi.
disclaimer: Mhinduro ifungidziro dzekuronga chete uye hadzitsivi zano renyanzvi. Gara uchiongorora mitemo yekuvaka yenzvimbo yako nemirairo yemugadziri.
